notes.title: Z Arena Sad Story!
notes.content:
Z Arena Sad Story!

I've started this project in 2015-09-14 completed the basics and paused developing after 2016.
Then I came back to the project so excited to complete the game 2021 the game was early access on steam I've been updating the game frequently till mid 2022 I had great plans for the game, unfortunately I have lost the project files, there was a big problem that cannot be solved! I can't update the game anymore and I am really sorry for those who were excited to play my game, I promise you that I am making a new awesome game and I'll keep making awesome games! this time I won't lose any project so don't worry! :)

I will open some previous versions so you can try some removed parts of the game including "Cold Edge Map" which had some performance issues.

I’m focused on providing all the help you need. I’ll be sharing guides with tips and strategies so you can fully enjoy what Z Arena has to offer. Whether you’re new to the game or have been playing since the start, these resources will help you get the most out of your experience.

Feel free to reach out in the community forums if you have any questions, or even share your own tips! I’ll be here to answer what I can and keep the discussions alive.

❗ Important Note: This note marks the final version of Z Arena. The game isn’t fully complete, and there are a few remaining bugs, but no further updates will be possible due to losing access to the project files. I hope you can still find enjoyment in the content that’s available.

💬 Join the Community: I’d love to see everyone continue sharing their thoughts, leaving reviews, and discussing the game. Your support has meant a lot, and your feedback helps other players understand what Z Arena is all about.

🚀 What’s Next: I’m thrilled to share that I’m currently working on a brand new project that’s set to be much bigger and more ambitious. Stay tuned, as more details will be coming soon, and you can expect to see it on Steam in the near future!

Thank you again for being part of this journey. It’s been an incredible experience as a solo developer, and I hope you enjoy what Z Arena brings, despite its limitations.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40374910/24a3d8e610094813d8c56c985bc51ed8ee1346d3.png[/img]
You can play "Cold Edge" map update using Steam Game Betas
How?
Select the game "Z Arena" in your library > Select "Manage" (the settings icon on the right) > Proprties.. > Betas > Select "Cold Edge Map" from the dropdown list.

notes.title: 2021 Major Update | Batter Gameplay Experience
notes.content:
Working hard to provide the best quality and performance.
but here we are back with a better gameplay experience!

[h2][ Major Updates ][/h2]
[list]
[*]  Switching weapons now available! you can switch between primary weapon from the wall and a static secondary gun for your characters. "More coming soon".
[*]  New weapons "TEC-S" secondary "TEC-M" primary.
[*]  A Copy of map "Havoc" without Kate now available
        [olist]
[*] The main gate is disabled.
[*]         Map is in the morning.
[*]         Removed "Kate".
[*]         No extraction mission.
[/olist]
[*]  Added headshot and kill markers.
[*]  Added reverb zones to different areas now will sound more realistic.
[*]  Added a new skin for "M21" : Sharp Edged, available in the armory for 3000 ZC.
[*]  New puzzle "for testing" on map "The Factory"! Shoot the glowing cubes to unlock the golden TEC-M.
[/list]

[h2][ General Changes and Fixes ][/h2]
[list]
[*]  Fixed getting stuck in trees on "Deathrattle".
[*]  New fonts for hit score and head shot score and others.
[*]  Added slide animation and changed texts styles when pointing on items to buy.
[*]  New kill sound effects.
[*]  Increased brightness on "Deathrattle".
[*]  Fixed some issues in Armory.
[*]  Fixed weapons customization panels.
[*]  Fixed many bugs on "Havoc" and getting through walls.
[*]  Now you can skip the second scene when playing "Havoc".
[*]  Changed the way "Ammo texts" are appearing, now its smaller and more clear.
[*]  Replaced pistol floating from the last update.
[*]  New UI when selecting a map.
[*]  Added map difficulty when hovering on the map's image.
[*]  Changed weapon's red dots to move dynamically with the weapon's rotation, you can view that with these weapons : "Master 21", "LC", "TEC-M".
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374910/6445e196c1ac14d754592e32dc7defea8213a429.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374910/56d77f1175bf5c843a4aeaa01cc60d902c9beb6f.png[/img]

[h1][BIG ANNOUNCEMENT][/h1]
[b]Story Mode is now temporary closed for bug fixes that ruined the gameplay, its coming back when all parts are completed.[/b]

[h3]Winter Update Coming Soon Stay Toned[/h3]

Please report any kind of bugs on : itsbasem.com/zarena
I appreciate your support.

notes.title: New map, New mission!
notes.content:
[h1][ Major Changes ][/h1]
[list]
[b][*] New map "HAVOC" comes with a mission.
[*] Z Coins !! New way of getting hands on things in Z Arena.
[*] Customization Machine available on all Endless Mode maps.
[*] Now you can buy a customized weapon from the armory using Z Coins.

[list]
[*] Smoothed player movement by 40% when turning around while running or walking.

[*] Adjusted (FOV) Field Of View to be more by 10 points on map "HAVOC".
[*] Added more realistic trees providing less heat on CPU.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed lag on GPU when reaching high waves/rounds.
